full_page.content:
1939, July 10
The following is a faithful transcription of hand written messages written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap. on Seraphic Mass Association Card and Certificate.
Owen B. Casey with associates - for God's grace and guidance -
July 10, 1939
God bless you Brother Owen.
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
1951. June. 18th
Mrs. Martha Casey - for her special intention. God willing, and for His holy guidance ---
Emergency special Membership
Of course we be glad to pray for same too. Fr. Sol.
June 18th, 1951
God bless you Martha; you and yours. Glory be to God that you all seem to be well. Keep it up. Foster Confidence in divine Pro- vidence. It will be "crying necessary" be- fore many decades - of months - even of weeks.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
